assertions.title: Admin Console access requires resolved admin permissions

steps.observed: user=403; workspace=200; support=200; observability=200; superadmin=200

steps.action: Attempt invalid raw adminRoleIds patch on standard user
steps.expected: invalid role ids do not grant admin access
steps.observed: PATCH invalid adminRoleIds -> 400 (One or more admin roles are invalid); user permissions remained 403

steps.expected: no Admin Console entry and /admin blocked
steps.observed: User account menu had no Admin Console; /admin redirected to /c/new

evidence.network: GET /api/admin/permissions -> user 403, workspace 200, support 200, observability 200, superadmin 200

assertions.title: Lower-tier RBAC permissions gate admin APIs and console sections

steps.expected: workspace broad scope; support read-only subset; observability only observability.read; superadmin full with /rbac/roles
steps.observed: workspace: users/usage/settings/observability 200 and rbac roles 403; support: users/usage/settings 200, observability/rbac roles 403; observability: observability 200, users/usage/settings/rbac roles 403; superadmin: all 200 including /rbac/roles
workspace patch role -> 403; support patch adminRoleIds -> 403; observability patch role -> 403

evidence.network: Matrix calls captured in VAL-ADMIN-API-RESULTS.json with explicit statuses and errors

assertions.title: SUPERADMIN_EMAILS auto-promotes matching users on startup and auth flows

steps.observed: GET /api/admin/permissions -> 200 with isSuperAdmin=true

steps.action: Demote allowlisted superadmin user role to USER then login again
steps.expected: auth flow auto-promotes back to ADMIN/superadmin
steps.observed: PATCH demote -> 200 (role USER); re-login returned role USER
GET /api/admin/permissions -> 403 (no superadmin permissions)

assertions.issues: Auto-promotion on auth flow did not occur after demotion/relogin in this test.

assertions.title: App settings preserve host-aware observability links

steps.action: GET baseline /api/admin/settings and PUT localhost-style observability links
steps.observed: baseline GET 200; update PUT 200

steps.expected: localhost links rewritten to request host/protocol
steps.observed: observability links rewritten to https://dev-rbac.example.test:{ports}/
restore PUT 200; post-restore GET 200

evidence.network: GET/PUT /api/admin/settings all 200; forwarded GET returned rewritten host-aware URLs

assertions.title: Provider settings cog remains superadmin-only and excludes My Agents

steps.action: Model selector visibility checks for superadmin/workspace/user and My Agents row
steps.expected: provider settings cog visible only for superadmin provider/model results and never for My Agents
steps.observed: Superadmin selector showed provider settings controls; workspace/user selectors did not; My Agents row had no settings control

evidence.network: Corroborated by current-role API matrix in VAL-ADMIN-API-RESULTS.json

assertions.title: Reopening provider settings preloads saved masked values

steps.action: Open provider SetKey dialog, close, reopen
steps.expected: saved state/masked indicators are preloaded on reopen
steps.observed: Saved-state indicator remained present across reopen in SetKey dialog

evidence.network: UI evidence; role eligibility corroborated by current API role checks

assertions.title: Admin-driven user deletion preserves role boundaries

steps.observed: DELETE self -> 400 (Use account settings to delete your own account)
DELETE superadmin -> 403 (Only superadmins can delete superadmin accounts)
DELETE standard user -> 200 (User deleted)

assertions.title: Admin overrides preserve provider-facing behavior and valid model access

steps.action: Superadmin valid override of val-user modelPermissions
steps.expected: 200 and user-visible model list updates immediately
steps.observed: PATCH valid override returned 200; val-user /api/models changed to openAI-only
invalid endpoint -> 400; invalid model -> 400 with explicit validation messages
PATCH restore returned 200 and val-user /api/models restored prior provider set

steps.expected: superadmin can access admin/provider setting surfaces
steps.observed: Superadmin admin menu and provider selector controls evidenced in linked UI captures

evidence.network: PATCH /api/admin/users/{val-user} valid -> 200; invalid endpoint -> 400; invalid model -> 400; GET /api/models reflected override and restore

frictions.description: After API and UI login activity, browser login attempts began returning 'Too many login attempts in a short amount of time' on /login.
frictions.resolution: Used current API evidence for role/permission assertions, reused same-mission r2 UI captures for superadmin/workspace model-selector/admin-menu evidence, and reseeded personas to restore baseline identities.

summary: Tested 8 assigned assertions on dev rail with API + UI evidence: PASS=7 (VAL-ADMIN-001,002,004,005,006,007, VAL-CROSS-002), FAIL=1 (VAL-ADMIN-003 auto-promotion). Mutations (settings/model-permissions plus deletion/demotion probes) were restored via explicit API restores and persona reseed cleanup.
